data.name: Murshad
data.gender_notes: Murshad is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who guides or teaches others. The name Murshad carries the meaning “Guide, Teacher” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Pashto. Parents who choose Murshad usually hope their child will grow to embody guide, teacher and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Murshad belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Guide, Teacher.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Murshad total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: مرشد
in_arabic.meaning: مرشد تعني الدليل أو المربي أو من يقود الناس إلى الطريق المستقيم
in_arabic.long_meaning: مرشد هو اسم مشتق من الفعل 'أرشد' الذي يعني هداية الناس إلى الطريق الصحيح. في اللغة العربية، يُستخدم هذا الاسم للإشارة إلى الشخص الذي يقدم الإرشاد والدليل للآخرين. في القرآن الكريم، يُذكر مفهوم الإرشاد في عدة آيات، مثل 'وَيُضِلُ مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَيَهْدِي مَنْ يَشَاءُ' (الزمر: 41)، مما يدل على أهمية الهداية في الإسلام. تاريخياً، كان اسم مرشد يُستخدم في العديد من الثقافات الإسلامية للإشارة إلى الشخص الذي يلعب دور المرشد الروحي أو الديني.

in_urdu.name: مرشد
in_urdu.meaning: مرشد مطلب ہے رہنما یا آقا جو لوگوں کو سیدھے راستے پر چلائے
in_urdu.long_meaning: مرشد ایک عربی اسم ہے جو 'رشد' کے فعل سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے کسی کو صحیح راستے پر چلانا۔ اردو میں، یہ نام اس شخص کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے جو دوسروں کو رہنمائی اور مشورہ دیتا ہے۔ اسلامی روایت میں، رشد اور ہدایت کا موضوع بہت اہم ہے، جیسے کہ قرآن میں 'وَيُرِيدُ اللَّهُ لِكُمْ أَنْ تَضِلُّوا وَيُرِيدُ أَنْ يَجْعَلَ لَكُمْ طَرِيقًا مُسْتَقِيمًا' (النساء: 26)۔

in_hindi.name: मरशद
in_hindi.meaning: मरशद का अर्थ है मार्गदर्शक या स्वामी जो लोगों को सही रास्ते पर चलाए
in_hindi.long_meaning: मरशद एक अरबी नाम है जो 'रशद' के क्रिया से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है किसी को सही रास्ते पर चलाना। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम उस व्यक्ति के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है जो दूसरों को मार्गदर्शन और सलाह देता है। इस्लामी परंपरा में, रशद और हिदायत का विषय बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है, जैसे कि कुरआन में 'وَيَهْدِي مَنْ يَشَاءُ إِلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ' (البقرة: 213)।

in_pashto.name: مرشد
in_pashto.meaning: مرشد دليل معنی دے لرهونکی یا هغه چا چې خلکو ته سمه لار ښي
in_pashto.long_meaning: مرشد د عربي نوم څخه اخيستل شوی دی، چې د 'رشد' د فعل څخه مشتق دی، يعنی د چا بل ته سمه لار ښودل. په پښتو کلتور کې، دا نوم د هغه چا لپاره کارول کيږي چې نورو ته لارښوونې او مشورې ورکوي. په اسلامي دود کې، د رشد او هدايت موضوع ډېره مهمه ده، لکه څنګه چې په قرآن کې 'وَيَهْدِي مَنْ يَشَاءُ إِلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ' (البقرة: 213) تصديق شوی دی.

in_english.name: Murshad
in_english.meaning: Murshad means guide, leader, or one who shows the right path
in_english.long_meaning: The name Murshad is derived from the Arabic root 'r-sh-d', which means to guide or lead someone to the right path. In Islamic tradition, this name is used to refer to a person who provides guidance and direction to others. The concept of guidance is significant in Islam, as mentioned in the Quran, 'He misleads whom He wills and guides whom He wills' (Al-Zumar: 41). Historically, the name Murshad has been used in various Muslim cultures to signify a spiritual or religious leader.

data.cultural_impact: In Islamic tradition, the role of a Murshad or spiritual guide is highly regarded. They are individuals who have achieved a high level of knowledge and understanding of Islamic principles and practice, and are committed to guiding others on their spiritual journey. Murshads are respected and sought after for their wisdom, guidance, and support. They may work as teachers, scholars, or religious leaders, and their influence can extend beyond the local community to entire regions or even the global Muslim population.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Murshad holds deep spiritual significance as it reflects the infinite mercy, guidance, and compassion of Allah. The root of the word "Murshad" comes from the Arabic verb "rhisd," which means "to show mercy, to soften" or "to make easy." This resonates with the belief that Allah is the ultimate Murshad, guiding and protecting His creation through life's challenges. Murshads are individuals who emulate the qualities of Allah, acting as vessels for His divine guidance and mercy. They are agents of change, helping others develop a closer relationship with Allah and live a more pious and purposeful life.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Guide, Teacher" symbolizes One who guides or teaches others. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Murshad serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of guide, teacher.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.context: Ibn Hazm (d. 1064) used the term 'Murshid' to refer to spiritual guides and teachers in his seminal work Al-Muhalla, a comprehensive summary of Islamic jurisprudence and Sufi thought.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibn Arabi's The Meccan Revelations The name Murshad carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Ibn Arabi (d. 1240) referred to himself as 'Murshid' in his magnum opus, The Meccan Revelations, emphasizing his role as a spiritual guide and master in the Sufi tradition.
